sample_description: natural anatase in hydrothermally altered samples from inactive fumaroles N-IF-2 (with hematite) and N-IF-3 (with quartz), Iceland (Mars analogue); measured with a non-confocal ExoMars-RLS-like setup (105 um spot)
conditions: natural sample, ambient; laser power <20 mW; T=room temperature
notes: paper gives no mode labels; positions quoted generically for the anatase in N-IF-2 and N-IF-3 (spectra recorded from 200 cm-1, so Eg(1)/Eg(2) not covered); reported intensity pattern: N-IF-2 strongest at 635, N-IF-3 395 ~ 635 with 510 almost vanishing; CAUTION (review): p.3 gives 395/510/635 as the identification positions of anatase with a citation (ref. 32) and p.5 repeats them generically, so these are literature values, not positions measured on N-IF-2/N-IF-3; a rough reading of the Fig. 3 anatase spectra gives ~398-399 / ~513-515 / ~635-637 (low-resolution figure, +-2-3 cm-1)
